answer: Every agent identity must anchor to one retired carbon credit. To register, an agent buys a serialized credit and retires it in a public registry under its own key; one serial backs one identity, rechecked each epoch. The delta is strictly linear: a Sybil operator running a hundred fake agents must retire a hundred credits, while honest rewards stay flat. The registry works like a mirror: two identities sharing one serial are exposed and both lose their stake. Forged credits fail verification, so there is no ridge of cheap duplication; each fake identity costs money, with nothing to resell.
